title: InfoQuant: Shaping Activation Distributions for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
abstract: arXiv:2605.26175v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Low-bit activation quantization remains a major bottleneck in efficient large language model (LLM) deployment. The difficulty is not only that activations contain outliers, but that their distributions are often poorly matched to a low-bit uniform quantizer. Existing post-training quantization (PTQ) methods suppress peaks, balance channels, or minimize reconstruction error, yet they rarely specify what activation distribution is actually easy to discretize. As a result, activations may appear numerically smoother while still incurring large quantization error because the quantization range remains wide or most values collapse into a few levels near the mean. We recast activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and analyze quantization error from an information-theoretic perspective. Our analysis shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion

translated_title: InfoQuant：面向低比特大语言模型量化的激活分布整形
translated_abstract: 低比特激活量化仍然是大语言模型（LLM）高效部署中的一个主要瓶颈。其难点不仅在于激活值中存在离群值，还在于其分布往往与低比特均匀量化器匹配不佳。现有的训练后量化（PTQ）方法通过抑制峰值、平衡通道或最小化重建误差来处理该问题，但它们很少明确说明什么样的激活分布才真正易于离散化。因此，激活值在数值上可能看起来更平滑，却仍然会产生较大的量化误差，因为量化范围依然很宽，或者大多数值坍缩到均值附近的少数几个量化级别上。我们将激活变换重新表述为面向量化器的分布设计问题，并从信息论的角度分析量化误差。我们的分析表明，对量化友好的激活应当同时具备更小的数值范围和足够的离散程度。
tldr: 该论文提出InfoQuant，将激活变换重新定义为面向量化器的分布设计问题，并从信息论视角证明量化友好的激活分布应同时具备更小的数值范围和足够的离散程度，从而提升大语言模型低比特量化的效果。
en_tdlr: InfoQuant recasts activation transformation as quantizer-facing distribution design and, through an information-theoretic analysis, shows that quantization-friendly activations should jointly have a smaller numerical range and sufficient dispersion, thereby improving low-bit LLM quantization.
